scene_description: Scuffed, paint-stained wooden workbench. An empty filament spool lies flat with clear safety glasses resting on its top flange. An orange scraper lies flat with its blade end tucked under the front of the spool. Front is the bench edge nearest the viewer.

targets.name: filament spool
targets.description: Empty brown cardboard ELEGOO filament spool lying flat, with the glasses on top and the scraper under its front rim.
targets.clearance_notes: Side rims are open, but the glasses cover the top and center hole.

candidate_improvements.description: Lift the safety glasses off the spool and set them on the bench.

targets.other_notes: Spool is empty and may need to be replaced.

targets.name: 3D print scraper
targets.description: Orange plastic 3D print scraper lying flat in front of the spool, its blade end tucked under the spool's lower rim.
nearby_obstacles: Filament spool resting on its blade end
targets.clearance_notes: Handle is exposed, but the blade is pinned under the spool and it is only 0.5 cm thick.

candidate_improvements.description: Lift the spool off the scraper, then slide the scraper out.

targets.name: safety glasses
targets.description: Clear plastic safety glasses resting on top of the spool's upper flange, lens edge across the center hole.
targets.orientation: lying flat on top of the spool
targets.clearance_notes: Fully exposed on top of the spool; clear plastic is hard to see.

source: Staged permutation of S0041 and S0043, using the same objects in a different arrangement.
